Brad from Hedge Clippers Grubstakers 1h 24m This week we're joined by Brad from hedgeclippers.org to discuss billionaire "activist investor" Daniel S. Hear how he built his hedge fund fortune from small time message board pump and dumps to being one of the big players extorting companies into laying off workers and asset stripping themselves in order to give him a payday.
